summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Analytics' tab + 8 charts + regression on tab switching, Detail/Cashflow xlsx export and Compare tab. ALL 7 review-request bullets PASS with 0 console errors. The Analytics tab (data-testid='tab-analytics') is the 4th tab in the top bar (after Detail/Cashflow). Clicking it shows a brief 'Running analytics…' state, then renders [data-testid='analytics-grid'] containing all 8 chart panels. Each chart panel has a recharts SVG with legend items present: income-sources (8 legend items), bracket-fill (8: 10%/12%/22%/24%/32%/35%/37% + Marginal Rate, the right-axis step line is visible black line in screenshot), surplus (74 bar rectangles green/orange around y=0), tax-composition (5 stacked series), rmd-balance (3 series), irmaa (6 series), rate-trend (2 lines), cumulative-tax (2 areas). The Cumulative Lifetime Taxes chart shows BOTH 'With Conversions' and 'No Conversions' series and the two area paths have visibly divergent endpoints (last Y coords ~32 vs ~112 in SVG space → meaningfully different cumulative totals at year 2062). All 7 tabs (optimizer/projection/cashflow/analytics/inputs/scenarios/compare) reach data-state=active when clicked. Regression: [data-testid='export-full-plan'] on Detail/Cashflow downloads retirement_plan.xlsx; Compare tab still renders [data-testid='compare-selectors'].

critical_code_review_comments: Analytics.jsx runs two full projections back-to-back (with + without Roth). Uses a 300ms debounce + alive flag — good. However, if the underlying scenario already has roth.enabled=false, the two projections are identical (cumYes === cumNo) and the 'Cumulative Lifetime Taxes' chart will show a degenerate single line. Consider short-circuiting (noRoth = withRoth) when scenario.roth.enabled is already false to save one network round-trip and to avoid a misleading 'no benefit' read in that case.

Analytics.jsx mutates a deep-cloned scenario (noCfg.roth.enabled=false) — safe because of JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(scenario)), but if scenario ever contains non-JSON-serializable values (Dates, functions) this will silently drop them. Not currently an issue.

AnalyticsCharts.jsx uses dynamic Tailwind class `lg:col-span-${span}` in Panel — Tailwind JIT will only emit a class it can statically find. lg:col-span-1 and lg:col-span-2 are both used in the same file via literal numbers (1 and 2), but if anyone passes span=3 in the future the class will silently not exist. Consider an explicit map { 1:'lg:col-span-1', 2:'lg:col-span-2' } for safety.

IrmaaChart plots magi as an Area while tier thresholds are step-lines on the SAME left axis. If MAGI is much higher than the top tier threshold, tier steps compress visually near the x-axis. A log scale or a secondary axis with shared zero would read better — minor polish, not a defect.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing default scenario for Analytics rendering, and existing 'Aggressive 32% bracket' / 'No conversions' scenarios were not required for these 7 checks.
